Body.Content:
The improvements to project quote provide usability enhancements designed to modernize and streamline the experience. The goal is to reduce unnecessary complexity, improve clarity, and enable users to work more efficiently when creating and managing quotes.

The updated interface features an optimized layout and improved use of screen space, providing a cleaner, more efficient workspace for viewing and editing both project and product lines. You can access more relevant information at once with less visual clutter and fewer navigation steps, resulting in a more intuitive and productive workflow.

In addition, context-based insights are now surfaced directly within the quote, highlighting important details such as pricing indicators, estimate breakdowns, and potential data inconsistencies. These insights guide you toward more accurate quoting decisions and reduce the time needed to validate contract and estimate information.

Collectively, these enhancements deliver a smoother, more responsive, and more intuitive quoting experience, helping sales and project teams complete quotes with greater speed, accuracy, and confidence.

Business Value:

The enhanced project quote experience helps you work smarter and faster. By cutting unnecessary steps, simplifying the interface, and putting key insights right where you need them, you can make confident pricing decisions and finish quotes quickly. This means higher productivity, fewer mistakes, and faster turnaround for your business.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

GA date: April CY2027

Preview date: September CY2026
